# hibira_console_apps (Data Source)

Lists the apps of every account, or of one. Needs the provider's `console_token` (scope `apps:read`) and the Cloudflare Access service token. Secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hibira_console_apps" "demo" {
  account_id = data.hibira_account.demo.id
}

output "demo_app_keys" {
  value = [for app in data.hibira_console_apps.demo.apps : app.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) List only this account's apps.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) The apps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The owning account (empty for the service's own apps).
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) The allowed web origins.
- `client_events` (Boolean) Whether client events are on.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is enabled.
- `id` (String) The app ID.
- `key` (String) The app key.
- `name` (String) The app's name.
- `plan` (String) The app's plan.
